main.description: Publishes an Are.na channel as a gallery on /curating. The record key is the site-facing slug (e.g. weird-dogs-only → /curating/weird-dogs-only).

title.description: Optional title override; falls back to the channel title on are.na.

description.description: Optional description override; falls back to the channel description.

coverBlockId.description: Are.na block id fronting the gallery on /curating. Unset = the channel's first image, whatever blockOrder says.

blockOrder.description: Which order the gallery page opens in; readers can re-sort from the page. newest/oldest = when the block was connected to the channel (newest is the default); curated = are.na's own position order; random = reshuffled every visit.

pinnedBlockIds.description: Are.na block ids that lead the gallery, in this order, whatever blockOrder is set to or a reader sorts by. An id no longer in the channel places nothing.

order.description: Sort order on the /curating index — lower sorts first.

enabled.description: When false, the gallery is hidden from the site.
